Next.js 16.2.2 app with App Router. Aged care compliance tracking for Australian facilities.

**Tech:** TailwindCSS 4, Recharts, Lucide-React, localStorage (no database), @react-pdf/renderer

**Pages:** /dashboard, /shifts, /staff, /forecast, /alerts, /reports, /settings, /admin, /onboarding

**Key data:** lib/dummyData.js (facility, staff, shifts), lib/compliance.js (RAG status, penalty calcs), lib/useLocalStorage.js

**App color:** #22c55e (green compliant), #f59e0b (amber), #ef4444 (red), #1e293b (sidebar dark)

**Why:** Compliance tracking for ACQSC — 215 min/resident/day total, 44 min RN minimum, $31.64/resident penalty for non-compliance.

**Mobile:** Bottom nav (BottomNav.js) for mobile, Sidebar (Sidebar.js) hidden on mobile with md:hidden/hidden md:flex.
